deltas.description: Only the finite-integral entropy comparison is asserted; the complete displayed infimum formula in arbitrary extended-real cases is not formalized here.

review_evidence: cost_nonneg uses the elementary logarithm inequality, splitting s=0. cost_expand and integrable_cost justify all linearity in integral_cost, where probability mass one yields the cost at the mean. entropy_le_integral_cost follows from nonnegativity of that mean cost. The theorem transfers reference integrability to nu, handles mean zero by AE zero and absolute continuity, and otherwise chooses t equal to the positive mu mean. Domination compares the nonnegative cost; its reference integral is exactly Ent_mu(g). The target inequality is proved, not assumed.
